title: Analysis code for: Optimized Cardiorespiratory State at Tone Onset Enhances Sensory Responses but Not Associative Learning in Healthy Adults
description: MATLAB analysis code (EEG, ECG, respiration and EMG) for Santhana Gopalan & Nokia, European Journal of Neuroscience (2026). Covers preprocessing, identification of each participant's optimal cardiorespiratory state from the composite N1–P2 response, CS-evoked ERPs and time–frequency analysis during trace eyeblink conditioning, and conditioned-response scoring. Participant data are not included.
